preregistered_leakage_ablation.justification: PREREGISTERED before Phase-3 results: (a) rare_token_ratio/mean_log_df are document-frequency statistics of the MAGE training corpus and transfer poorly by construction; (b) TTR-family features are length/corpus-composition dependent (Phase-2 E7 drift: hapax_ratio Cohen-d -1.07 MAGE vs HC3 machine text); (c) boilerplate/transition/connective phrase rates are generator-vintage lexicons (Phase-2 E7: boilerplate_rate 0.10 MAGE machine vs 0.64 HC3 machine); (d) hash/bullet/header rates and uppercase_word_ratio are markdown/source formatting artifacts, not authorship evidence (Phase-2 hswag forensics showed formatting/length artifacts dominating errors).
